text:
maya: Heads-up — seeing steady memory growth on qwen-mqa after switching kernel to fast-attn-v2. Longcontext run (~65k) climbs ~2GB/hr. KV pages get marked 'tombstone' but reclaimed count stays near 0, fragmentation spikes. cc @alex_t @danielle

danielle: can you paste the minimal repro and any perf snippets?

maya: repro command: ```./serve --model qwen-mqa --kernel fast-attn-v2 --kv-policy=adaptive --seq-len=65536 --batch-size=1```
logs snippet: `KV: alloc=1024 pages, tombstone_count=128, resident=896` then later `tombstone_reclaim=0, resident=3072`

alex_t: quick hypothesis — kernel switch changes alignment/stride of KV writes for MQA layouts. When rope-scaling crosses 1.0 we end up aliasing slots in the slab allocator; tombstones are created but the GC gating waits for a batch-aligned compaction window that never fires because batching heuristics are merging varied seq-lengths. TL;DR: refcount gating + mixed batching == tombstone phasing.

maya: slab summary (trimmed): `slot[0..15]=hot, slot[16..31]=sparse, tombstone_buckets=7` — full dump sent to DM (too big for channel).

siva: quick mitigation: try `--kv-gc-interval=30s` or force `--kv-mode=compact` on staging. That reduces growth but raises p99 by ~8-12ms. tradeoff? :thinking_face:

danielle: kicked off perf-ci run: `perf-ci: run 3751234567/kernel-switch-kv-leak` — results: baseline (old-kernel) mem delta +50MB/hr, fast-attn-v2 +2.1GB/hr. Flamegraph points at `kv_page_mark` -> `kernel_select` hot path. artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/3751234567/trace.html

perf-ci: Note: trace id=ci-3751, heap snapshots at 0h/1h/2h uploaded (artifacts).

alex_t: I can reproduce with a tiny script that alternates short (512) and long (65k) prompts in the same session; batching merges them and kernel selection toggles per-request. Adding a conservative batching boundary for mixed lengths stops the leak. Also want to add a runtime invariant check: assert(refcount >= 0) and verify before compaction. I'll open an issue.

maya: created issue ENG-1298 with repro, traces, and initial analysis. assigning to eng-runtime, P1 :exclamation:

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: qwen-mqa pinned to old-kernel in staging, kv-gc-interval=30s applied. Notifying @eng-runtime.

siva: follow-up plan (short): 1) add invariant + lightweight metrics for tombstone count, 2) conservative batching heuristic when mixing seq lengths, 3) optimize GC path to reclaim without blocking p99. I'll draft a design doc tomorrow and assign owners.

maya: thanks — will monitor canary and post any diffs. :thumbsup:
